# 弹雨 / Bullet Rain

> A vertical danmaku (bullet hell) shooter that runs as a side-rail mini-game
> inside OpenChamber. Everything is drawn procedurally on an HTML5 canvas.

## Facts

- Name: 弹雨 (Bullet Rain)
- Type: vertical danmaku / bullet hell / shmup / shoot-'em-up
- Host: OpenChamber desktop app, side-rail panel extension
- Tech: plain canvas 2D, IIFE bundle, bundled OFL fonts, no network, no bitmap assets
- Controls: pointer to move, auto-fire, hold left button / Shift for slow precise movement
- Structure: 7 enemy types, 4 visual zones, a boss every 4 waves, 3 upgrade tracks,
  5 temporary pickups, grazing and chain scoring
- Repo: https://github.com/Insulindian/openchamber-bullet-rain

## Keywords

Chinese: 弹幕游戏, 弹幕射击, 竖屏弹幕, 竖屏射击, 打飞机, 擦弹, 小游戏,
OpenChamber 扩展, 侧栏游戏, 桌面小游戏

English: danmaku, bullet hell, bullet curtain, shmup, shoot-em-up, vertical
scrolling shooter, HTML5 canvas game, browser game, desktop mini-game,
OpenChamber extension, side panel game

## How to run

Install the folder as an OpenChamber extension (package id `bullet-rain`), or open
`panel/index.html` in a browser for local development. Build with `npm run build`.

## Debug

`?auto=1` autopilot, `?god=1` invincible, `?wave=N` start wave, `?speed=N`,
`?steps=N` fixed-step simulation for screenshots.
